notes.note: #0.196-209 is the party-leader block answering Zamsha's 'You saved me?' (labels 'Mebius' are carried over). Voiced from wording; identical JP -> identical EN. The object of 'evolve' is read as the Devil Gundam (Master Gundam just said the Life Core makes it evolve).

Rough variant (omee / mendokusee): same leader slot (k=11 of the Mebius-first chain 14,8,15,13,12,11,9,10,6,7,5,4,3,2,1) as rough #0.251-252, i.e. Pt_Chara_Check 4. story_122 put Momotaros at ID 3, so this may be W (Shotaro) or Den-O; written rough without Imagin tics so it fits either.
Script shows this row (n=209) under Ankh's name, right after a Pt_Chara_Check(13) gate; identical JP to the generic variant, so identical EN.
Zamsha: 'ore mo' = he too sees no point in winning as that monster (he had been absorbed as the Devil Gundam's Life Core). Archaic warrior register.
#0.213-227: 15 leader copies of 'Zamsha...'; script calls only the block base (n=212).

#0.229-258 = 15 leader pairs (reply to Ankh + request to call). Pair 0 polite with '-san' to Ankh (Mebius; -san dropped, politeness carried by 'could you please'). 'Tsuushin wo tanomu' rendered 'I need you to contact them' so the request runs speaker -> Ankh.
Tightened from 'how the Gundam Team is doing' to keep the row under 100 chars; meaning kept.
Narration; tsuushin wo ireta = placed a call. The next row says it never connects.
Ankh is handling comms, so 'renraku suru ka?' rendered as Ankh offering ('Should I...'); could also be 'Should we'. Seravee's group = the separate covert team.
#0.280-294 leader block continues into story_126; voiced from wording (#0.281 curt 'should refrain' = Heero-like).

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks voiced from wording; labels 'Mebius' are carried over. Uncertain: #0.207/#0.251-252 rough leader (W or Den-O); #0.210 shown under Ankh's name; #0.279 'Should I' vs 'Should we'. Not in glossary: Gundam Team (used before).
